description: This source file defines a C# Roslyn analyzer that enforces rules around serialization and member modifiers in classes or structs within the Orleans.Analyzers namespace. It implements diagnostic analysis to identify invalid abstract or static members that should not be serialized.

classes.name: AbstractPropertiesCannotBeSerializedAnalyzer
classes.description: A Roslyn DiagnosticAnalyzer that checks for improper use of abstract and static members in serializable types.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Configures the analysis context, enabling concurrent execution, generated code analysis, and registering syntax node actions for class and struct declarations.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Performs analysis on class and struct declarations to identify abstract or static members that should not be serialized, reporting diagnostics accordingly.
